scope: Eight actual desktop/mobile checkpoint/cumulative screenshots: sampled systems, spectral/IQ, CFAR uncertainty and pulsed-radar capstone. Other checkpoints have automated navigation/content/accessibility/drawn-plot checks; no human learner or manual screen-reader result.
findings: P10/P20/P52/P84 checkpoint and cumulative assessment headings, tasks, rubrics and laboratory links are readable in the captured desktop and mobile views.
Long equations, identifiers and laboratory links wrap inside the mobile content column without horizontal clipping.
P84 explicitly distinguishes the selected first scan from the fixed eight-scan baseline; its excluded branches and authored-assessment boundary are visible.
These are visual inspections of eight captured assessment panels, not representative-learner or manual screen-reader validation.
